correctness.rationale: Independently checked all five boundary intervals and equality cases. Below t=1/2, bound by number s of winning singletons (s<=3 or s<=2); conditional binomial event requiring >=2 other successes produces the exact nonnegative differences (3-s)pq^3, pq^2(1-2p), pq^2(2-3p), using p<=t. Above 1/2 winning pairs form an intersecting graph; every intersecting-edge family on four vertices lies in a star or triangle. With no winning singleton, triangle/star bounds <=3p^2-2p^3, and no pairs yields <=4p^3-3p^4. Above 2/3 no triangle of winning edges exists; two winning edges force all winning sets to contain their common vertex, one winning edge forces a fixed endpoint, and without pairs at most four winning triples give <=p using p<=t<=3/4 when all four win. One-, two-, three-, four-equal vectors attain all pieces. Independently checked exact rational Bernoulli sums on all 5,940, 35,490 and 371,910 grid-weight/parameter combinations for denominator 8,12,20, with no upper-bound violation. Grid is corroborative, not real-continuum proof.
